milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because harvesting mature wheat (age=7) drops wheat items directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with only raw mutton and coal — no wheat — so this cannot be pre-satisfied. Breaking any of the 16 mature wheat blocks in the 4x4 field guarantees at least 1 wheat drop.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw mutton in the furnace produces cooked_mutton which the player must retrieve into their inventory. The player starts with 4 raw mutton and 4 coal but zero cooked_mutton, so this cannot be pre-satisfied. The furnace is placed at spawn-relative (7, 0, 3) and is accessible just beyond the wheat field.
